key_terms.أُولَٰئِكَ: Those (referring to the believers described previously)

ai.seo_question: Who are the true inheritors of Paradise according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse concludes the detailed portrait of the *Mu'minun* (believers) in Surah Al-Mu'minun, emphasizing that true inheritance of Paradise is earned through the internalization of faith manifested in ethical conduct and spiritual presence. The term *al-Warithun* implies a permanent, exclusive possession of the Divine promise, distinguishing them from those who merely claim belief without practicing its tenets. This serves as a theological anchor for the concept of *Amal-e-Salih* (righteous deeds) as the essential criterion for salvation.
